name: tvtcommerce/module-qr-code-generator
description: Adds a "Generate QR Code" button to the admin Product and Category edit pages, producing a downloadable PNG QR code that encodes the entity's storefront URL — handy for printing on tags, flyers, and POS materials. Reuses the same endroid/qr-code library Magento core's own Magento_TwoFactorAuth module already depends on for its Google Authenticator QR codes.
